title: How should authors handle a suspected auto-generated review at ICLR? Flag to the AC or just rebut? [D]
summary: I'm curious how ACs and experienced authors think about this. My situation: one ICLR reviewer gave a 2 with confidence 1. The other reviewers gave 3 with confidence 3. Pangram flags the review as 100% AI. I know detectors aren't proof on their own, but there are other signs too:
